details.s: Orodreth was a Ñoldorin Elf of the First Age who was the second ruler of the underground city of Nargothrond in western Beleriand. He was later killed in the Battle of Tumhalad.
f: Warden of Minas Tirith, King of Nargothrond
Ñoldor (House of Finarfin), Falmari (House of Olwë), Elves of Nargothrond
